backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor defining the backend for a comment/event/image management app, with functions for managing comment lists, app events, chat messages, images, settings, and template generation with device-based tracking.
backend/migration.mo: Trivial migration module that passes state through unchanged, serving as a no-op migration runner.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping feature IDs and titles to their target files, components, and test IDs, covering comment generation metadata handling, optimistic UI updates, and bulk generation clamping behavior.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Text file containing short summaries of each frontend source file, describing the purpose and recent changes of components, hooks, and views in the React frontend.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS entry file defining OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light and dark themes, covering colors for backgrounds, cards, borders, charts, and sidebar elements.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML shell for the React app titled 'App Content & Feedback Manager', mounting the app at the `#root` div and loading the main TypeScript entry point.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component providing the app shell with a sticky header (logo, countdown timer, music toggle), four-tab navigation (User View, Upload, Live Checker, Admin), floating decorative shapes, and background music management.
frontend/src/components/AdminUnlock.tsx: Admin authentication gate component rendering a 4-digit code input form that calls the `useAdminAuth` hook to unlock admin access, with error display.
frontend/src/components/BulkCommentGener: A React component that lets users select a comment list, choose a quantity, and generate bulk comments using an access key, with optimistic UI updates for available comment counts.
frontend/src/components/MetricsDonutChar: An SVG-based donut chart component that visualizes the ratio of used to total templates as a percentage with a gradient arc.
frontend/src/components/TopDownShooter.t: A canvas-based top-down shooter mini-game where the player moves with keyboard input and shoots at spawning enemies by clicking, tracking score and time.
frontend/src/components/UploadComment.ts: A form component that allows users to type and submit a comment via the addChatMessage mutation, showing loading, success, and error states.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: A hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor using the current Internet Identity, invalidating dependent queries whenever the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminAuth.ts: A hook that manages admin authentication state using a hardcoded PIN code, persisting the unlocked status in sessionStorage.
frontend/src/hooks/useBackgroundMusic.ts: A hook that manages background audio playback for a given URL, supporting enable/disable toggling and exposing play/pause controls.
frontend/src/hooks/useCommentGenerator.t: A hook providing utility functions to generate single or bulk comments by randomly picking templates from a CommentList and optionally appending a suffix or symbol.
frontend/src/hooks/useCountdown.ts: A hook that returns a live countdown (hours, minutes, seconds) to the next midnight, updating every second.
frontend/src/hooks/useDeviceId.ts: A hook that retrieves or generates a persistent unique device ID stored in localStorage.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and hook for Internet Identity authentication on the ICP platform, managing login state, identity persistence, and AuthClient lifecycle.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for fetching and mutating backend data including comment lists, bulk comment generation, available counts, and other app entities.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that imports fonts, configures Tailwind CSS, and defines custom CSS variables and utility classes for a dark neon/glassmorphism design theme.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that renders the React app wrapped with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/utils/templateGenerator.ts: Utility module that generates randomized app review comment templates based on configurable tone, category, and length parameters.
frontend/src/views/admin/AdminAITemplate: An admin view for generating comment templates locally (no external AI) based on a topic, tone, count, and optional appended symbol, with the ability to select and bulk-add generated templates to a chosen comment list.
frontend/src/views/admin/AdminChat.tsx: An admin chat panel that displays timestamped messages fetched from the backend (auto-refreshing every 5 seconds) and allows sending new messages via an input field.
frontend/src/views/admin/AdminComments.t: An admin panel for managing comment lists: creating lists, adding templates, toggling lock state, viewing donut-chart metrics, and resetting comment pools with an optional claims-clear confirmation dialog.
frontend/src/views/admin/AdminImages.tsx: An admin view for uploading images (with name, tags, file picker, preview, and upload-progress bar) and displaying the existing image library with tag badges.
frontend/src/views/admin/AdminLiveList.t: Admin panel tab for managing live lists (apps/events): supports creating, renaming, deleting lists, adding usernames via textarea or file upload, and checking which lists contain specific usernames.
frontend/src/views/admin/AdminSettings.t: Admin settings panel for managing background music (toggle and file upload) and the access key used to gate the Bulk Comments Generator.
frontend/src/views/admin/AdminView.tsx: Top-level admin panel component that gates access behind AdminUnlock and renders tabbed sub-views for Comments, AI Templates, Images, Chat, Live List, and Settings.
frontend/src/views/LiveChecker.tsx: A React view component that allows users to check whether usernames exist within app/event lists, displaying found and not-found results per app.
frontend/src/views/UploadView.tsx: A view component that provides three upload sections: uploading a single comment, generating bulk comments via BulkCommentGenerator, uploading comment templates from a text file to a selected list, and uploading rating images with a name field.
frontend/src/views/UserView.tsx: A user-facing view that lets users select a comment list, generate a single comment (with device-based locking via localStorage), display the result, and copy it to clipboard, with optimistic available-count updates.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the default theme with custom fonts, oklch-based color tokens, neon shadows, border radii, and keyframe animations for the app's dark gradient UI.
project_state.json: Project state snapshot describing the app's full feature set, architecture (Motoko backend, React frontend, sessionStorage admin auth), known issues, and versioned list of implemented features.
